description: This file defines the HttpResponse class, which models HTTP response messages including status code, reason phrase, headers, cookies, body, and connection options. It provides static builders for common responses and methods to manipulate response components.

classes.name: HttpResponse
classes.description: Represents an HTTP response with status, headers, cookies, body, and connection options. Includes static builders and methods for response manipulation.

methods.name: response
methods.description: Creates a 200 OK HttpResponse with the specified body.

methods.name: withBody
methods.description: Sets the response body as a string.

methods.name: withBody
methods.description: Sets the response body as a string with specified Charset.

methods.name: withBody
methods.description: Sets the response body as a string with specified MediaType.

methods.name: withBody
methods.description: Sets the response body as binary data.

methods.name: withBody
methods.description: Sets the body with a BodyWithContentType instance.

methods.name: getBodyAsRawBytes
methods.description: Returns the body as raw bytes.

methods.name: getBodyAsString
methods.description: Returns the body as a string.

methods.name: withHeaders
methods.description: Sets headers from list of Header objects.

methods.name: withHeaders
methods.description: Sets headers from varargs of Header objects.

methods.name: withHeader
methods.description: Adds a header with name and values.

methods.name: withHeader
methods.description: Adds a header with NottableString name and values.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Returns list of values for a header.

methods.name: getFirstHeader
methods.description: Returns first value of a header.

methods.name: containsHeader
methods.description: Checks if header with name and value exists.

methods.name: withCookies
methods.description: Sets cookies from list of Cookie objects.

methods.name: withCookies
methods.description: Sets cookies from varargs of Cookie objects.

methods.name: withCookie
methods.description: Adds a cookie with name and value.

methods.name: withCookie
methods.description: Adds a cookie with NottableString name and value.

methods.name: cookieHeaderDoesNotAlreadyExists
methods.description: Checks if cookie header with given Cookie object does not exist.

methods.name: cookieHeaderDoesNotAlreadyExists
methods.description: Checks if cookie header with given name and value does not exist.

methods.name: shallowClone
methods.description: Creates a shallow clone of the response.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a deep clone of the response.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates response with override and modifier.
